title: The Expensive coat in the window
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：expensive　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 expensive 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the observer wrote of ① an expensive coat in the window in the log, and everybody in the observatory said at once that it was ② more expensive than the one named there the year before. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the observer, who never explained anything, had done it on the same day and gone home; it was the expensive ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most expensive coat in the window anybody in the observatory had ever seen, or so the log for November 1969 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too expensive to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the assistant who had come to help; the expensive ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the lens at the far dome, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an expensive mistake in the accounts, and said that no assistant in his right mind would call it ⑥ as expensive as the mistake in the accounts they had once had in the old observatory. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was expensive or not, and he said so.

By 1982 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the log. What the line asked for was ⑦ something expensive, and nothing besides. The assistant from the next observatory called the whole plan ⑧ quite expensive; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the log kept the names of the expensive ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1985, before dawn, she wrote of another expensive coat in the window in the same log, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ more expensive than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most expensive mistake in the accounts in the whole observatory, she said in 1987, was the one she could never quite name; the expensive ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 昂贵（前置定语 an expensive coat in the window：1975 年观测员在观测记录里记下的那件昂贵的外套）
B. adj. 昂贵／代价高昂（比较级 more expensive than：文中两处，一处比橱窗里的外套，一处比预想）
C. adj. 昂贵／代价高昂（最高级 the most expensive：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 昂贵（表语 too expensive to do：母亲觉得它太昂贵，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 代价高昂（前置定语 an expensive mistake in the accounts：叔叔把整件事称作一桩代价高昂的错误）
F. adj. 代价高昂（同级比较 as expensive as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩账目上代价高昂的错误相比）
G. adj. 代价高昂（后置定语 something expensive：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 代价高昂（受程度副词修饰 quite expensive：那位助手的评价）

items.q: an expensive coat in the window
the most expensive coat in the window anybody
an expensive mistake in the accounts
The most expensive mistake in the accounts in

answers.why: expensive 意为“昂贵”，1975 年观测员在观测记录里记下的是“一件昂贵的外套”，此处作前置定语 an expensive coat in the window。
expensive 意为“昂贵”，此处用比较级 more expensive than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
expensive 意为“昂贵”，观测记录上 十一月 那行字说它是观测站里最昂贵的一件，故用最高级 the most expensive coat in the window。
expensive 意为“昂贵”，母亲认为这件东西“太昂贵了，谁也用不上”，too expensive to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
expensive 意为“代价高昂”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩代价高昂的错误”，此处作前置定语 an expensive mistake in the accounts。
expensive 意为“代价高昂”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩账目上代价高昂的错误一样代价高昂”，同级比较用 as expensive as。
expensive 意为“代价高昂”，观测记录上那半行字要的是“代价高昂的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something expensive。
expensive 意为“代价高昂”，邻观测站来的那位助手认为这套计划“相当代价高昂”，quite 修饰原级 expensive。
expensive 意为“代价高昂”，1985 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要代价高昂”，故用比较级 more expensive than。
expensive 意为“代价高昂”，母亲 1987 年说的是“整个观测站里最代价高昂的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most expensive mistake in the accounts。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1975 年，观测员在观测记录里记下了一件昂贵的外套。（an expensive coat in the window）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更昂贵。（more expensive than …）
母亲觉得它太昂贵，谁也用不上。（too expensive to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩代价高昂的错误。（an expensive mistake in the accounts）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩账目上代价高昂的错误一样代价高昂。（as expensive as …）
到了 1982 年，观测记录上只剩半行字：要的是一件代价高昂的东西。（something expensive）
answers: In 1975 the observer wrote of an expensive coat in the window in the log.
Everybody said it was more expensive than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too expensive to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an expensive mistake in the accounts.
He said nobody would call it as expensive as the mistake in the accounts they had once had.
By 1982 the log asked for nothing but something expensive.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 expensive 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1975 the observer wrote of an expensive coat in the window in the log, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most expensive coat in the window in the observatory, or so the log says.
My mother thought it too expensive to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an expensive mistake in the accounts, and nobody argued with him.
The assistant from the next observatory called the plan quite expensive, and everybody laughed.
The expensive ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
